conditions: Retention limited to minimum period necessary
Deletion required upon contract termination or expiration
Deletion required upon Bank's written request
Deletion must be completed within 30 days unless otherwise agreed in writing
Deletion must include information held by affiliates or subcontractors
fields.source_fact: The Service Provider shall retain Personal Information only for the minimum period necessary to fulfill its obligations under the Agreement or as required by applicable law. Upon termination or expiration of the Agreement, or at any time upon the Bank's written request, the Service Provider shall securely delete all Personal Information in its possession or control, including that held by its affiliates or subcontractors, within thirty (30) days unless otherwise agreed in writing.

conditions: Assurance service providers may be ineligible to provide procured goods or services
Selected proponent may be ineligible to provide assurance services during contract term
Eligibility depends on interaction with Bank's accounting systems and processes
fields.source_fact: Depending on the specific requirement and how the procured goods or services may interact with the Bank's accounting systems and processes, service providers providing, or scheduled to provide during the term of the proposed contract, assurance services to the Bank may be determined to be ineligible to provide the procured goods or services. Similarly, the selected proponent may, during the term of the proposed contract with the Bank as contemplated under this RFP, be ineligible to provide assurance services to the Bank.
